Senior Rust Engineer, Desktop

We are building an offline-first desktop application with SQLite as the source of truth. You will own the storage layer and the egui front end, and you will care about migrations, crash safety, and startup time.

Requirements: six or more years of Rust, production SQLite, a desktop UI toolkit (egui preferred), and a habit of writing tests before shipping. You will work with a small team on a product used by thousands of people every day, with no on-call rotation and no Kubernetes requirement.

Nice to have: encryption at rest, local-first sync, and experience with cross-platform packaging. This is a permanent role in London with hybrid working.
